conditions_note: off: LANGSMITH_TEST_TRACKING=false; on: the variable unset, the default; ep: LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT set to a local recorder and a dummy key; noenv: no LANGSMITH_ variable, with the HTTP layer replaced by a guard that refuses or answers 200; output: --langsmith-output; logcli: log_cli at INFO; tracing: LANGSMITH_TRACING=true
machine: an x86 server guest: 32 vCPU, 48 GiB, Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.13.18
not_used: with tracking on, the errors after each request come from the empty answers of the recorder and the guard, so only the request order is used; the run names come from a rough match on the body, so the summary keeps only whether the LangGraph run of the agent was posted
tests: five tests: a marked test that logs inputs, outputs, reference outputs, and feedback; a marked test that fails on purpose; a test with @langsmith.test; a marked test that runs create_agent with ChatOllama and qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M, temperature 0, seed 42; an unmarked test that calls log_outputs
versions: langsmith 0.14.17 with its pytest11 plugin, pytest 8.4.2 in a scratch environment, rich 15.0.0, no vcrpy
